segments.tts: AI just beat eight brain tumor experts at their own job – and that's only the start of this week.

At a pathology conference, Mayo Clinic researchers tested an AI on 100 brain tumor cases, choosing from 52 tumor types using tissue images. It scored 97 percent – beating all eight specialists. Even better: doctors got more accurate when the AI helped them.

Next: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code mathematically checked the encryption code behind Signal's private chats – millions of lines of proof in just four weeks. When researchers slipped in two old bugs, it caught both.
Quick hit: AlphaGenome 2 reads DNA cell type by cell type, finding nearly twice as many gene-changing variants – clues to where diseases begin.
